root_cause.text: The hns3 PF VLAN mailbox handling in hclge_set_vlan_filter() trusted a VF-supplied VLAN ID without bounds checking before using it to index the fixed-size vlan_del_fail_bmap bitmap sized for VLAN_N_VID entries, leading to out-of-bounds access for VLAN IDs >= VLAN_N_VID.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE/commit states “the VLAN id may be used without validation when receive a VLAN configuration mailbox from VF” and that “the length of vlan_del_fail_bmap is BITS_TO_LONGS(VLAN_N_VID),” while the patch adds `if (vlan_id >= VLAN_N_VID) return -EINVAL;` at the start of `hclge_set_vlan_filter()`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add an early bounds check for vlan_id in hclge_set_vlan_filter() to reject invalid VLAN values with -EINVAL.
intent_record.what: A new early validation check was added at the start of hclge_set_vlan_filter() to test whether vlan_id is greater than or equal to VLAN_N_VID, and if so the function immediately returns -EINVAL.
intent_record.how: This prevents the function from processing invalid VLAN IDs at runtime, avoiding recording or programming out-of-range VLAN values while signaling the caller with an invalid-argument error.
